messages:
anita: Internal GA: shipping Delta-Bridge (low-latency tool bridge) + delta-lite-2b to Hosted API. Going internal-first, external post after canary. :sparkles:

anita: Why Delta-Bridge: single-path tool invocation with faster turnarounds for tool-heavy agents, implicit backpressure handling, and smaller per-call overhead for short tool calls. Expect lower TTFB on tool responses in multi-tool flows.

jaspar: Wire changes: stream chunks may include `bridge_meta` fragments and HTTP fallbacks include header `x-rw-bridge-id`. Billing adds `bridge_token_v1`. No breaking changes to existing toolcall payloads.

qa-bot: Quick smoke (works with existing keys):
```
curl -N -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streaming/generate?bridge=delta \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"delta-lite-2b","input":"Check SKU price","tools":[{"name":"price.lookup","input":{"sku":"X123"}}]}'
```

infra-bot: Rollout plan: canary us-west-2 now (20m), eu-west-1 in 90m, then global. Monitor `bridge.latency.p95`, `bridge.reassembly.failures`, and `tool.bridge.errors`. Page eng-oncall if errors >2% for 10m.

billing-bot: Note: `bridge_token_v1` will show on invoices next cycle. Finance will apply a 30-day transition credit for early users.

anita: Action items: docs publish guide (jaspar), SDKs add fragment helpers (jaspar), eng watch canary (infra-bot), CS prep FAQ (anita).

jaspar: Canary update at 2190001140: us-west-2 canary green, minimal error delta. Proceeding with staged rollout.

anita: Thanks team  will post the customer-facing note in 1h if global rollout completes.
